title: yaks key keyword vocabulary
description: The keyword @yaks/key adds to a component vocabulary. A component declaring `key` is a TAG that rides the `key{of, value}` carrier: a key entity wearing it carries a value unique among that tag's values, so `email` beside `key{of,value}` is the sentence "this person answers to that address". The keyword is the carrier's own name — a tag on an edge says `edge`, a tag on a key says `key` — so one rule reads every carrier. Which tags exist is the application's to declare.
$comment: A vocabulary declaration in the JSON Schema sense: a URI naming this keyword set, plus the schema of each keyword. A vocab file declares it under $vocabulary; a loader registers it with loadVocab(docs, [keyKeywords]).

key.description: This component tags a key with the kind of value it carries. `true` names the kind after the component itself (an `email` component is the `email` kind); a string names it something else, for a vocabulary whose tag and its reading differ.
